## TemplateEngine.compileKeyboards() method

Compiles keyboard blocks from a template into executable functions.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static compileKeyboards(template: string, baseBlocks?: ReturnType<typeof TemplateEngine._processBaseBlocks>): {
        [baseId: string]: {
            [lang: string]: {
                inline?: (data?: Record<string, any>) => string[];
                bottom?: (data?: Record<string, any>) => string[];
            };
        };
    };
```

{ \[baseId: string\]: { \[lang: string\]: { inline?: (data?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;) =&gt; string\[\]; bottom?: (data?: Record&lt;string, any&gt;) =&gt; string\[\]; }; }; }

Compiled keyboard functions organized by base ID, language, and mode

## Remarks

This method parses `<keyboard>` blocks from the template and compiles them into functions that generate button label arrays. The result is organized by base ID and language, with separate `inline` and `bottom` keyboard modes. Comma-separated labels are split into individual button strings.

## Example


```typescript
const template = `
  <base>
    <keyboard>Yes, No, {{action}}</keyboard>
    <keyboard type="bottom">Menu, Help</keyboard>
  </base>
`;
const keyboards = TemplateEngine.compileKeyboards(template);
const inline = keyboards.default.default.inline?.({ action: 'Cancel' });
// Result: ['Yes', 'No', 'Cancel']
```
